purpose: Project the one Type-1 component evidence graph into a sequence-aware 4D stack matrix for printable/hybrid smart embedded systems without duplicating catalogue authority.

stack_phases.name: DATUM_SUBSTRATE
stack_phases.rule: structure, datum, substrate and load path before dependent functional geometry

stack_phases.name: BARRIER_ADHESION
stack_phases.rule: surface preparation, adhesion, chemical/moisture/galvanic barriers as required

stack_phases.name: DIELECTRIC_ISOLATION
stack_phases.rule: dielectric, creepage/clearance and local field-control layers

stack_phases.name: FUNCTIONAL_PASSIVE
stack_phases.rule: resistive, capacitive, inductive, resonant, RF and other field geometry

stack_phases.name: EMBEDDED_ACTIVE_SEED
stack_phases.rule: insert source-bound semiconductor/optical/actuator/power seeds when local fabrication is not qualified

stack_phases.name: VERTICAL_INTERCONNECT
stack_phases.rule: vias, feedthroughs, transitions, terminations and cross-layer returns

stack_phases.name: SENSOR_CALIBRATION
stack_phases.rule: sensing/metrology/calibration geometry after disturbance-sensitive process steps

stack_phases.name: SERVICE_IDENTITY
stack_phases.rule: service bays, labels/identity, replacement paths and final readback

equations.capacitance: C≈epsilon0*epsilon_r*A/d for ideal parallel plate; geometry-specific analytic/field solve otherwise
equations.inductance: long-solenoid baseline L≈mu*N^2*A/l; planar/complex geometry uses established formula or EM solve
equations.resonance: f0≈1/(2*pi*sqrt(L*C)) only with explicitly bound effective L/C and parasitics
equations.thermal: Qdot=k*A*DeltaT/L; Rtheta=DeltaT/P under stated conduction/lumped assumptions
equations.mechanics: linear baseline sigma=E*epsilon; beam delta scales F*L^3/(E*I); thermal drift DeltaL=alpha*L*DeltaT
equations.laminar_flow: DeltaP=8*mu*L*Q/(pi*r^4) only for fully developed incompressible laminar circular flow
equations.optics: photon energy Eph=h*nu; device output remains exact-source/measurement governed
equations.uncertainty: first-order independent RSS may be used only when model is locally linear and covariance is negligible; otherwise propagate covariance/nonlinearity explicitly

numeric_rule: No numeric inference may replace a missing material constant, tolerance, boundary condition, calibration or exact seed rating. Derived values retain their source inputs, equation, units and uncertainty.

capacitance_example.status: SOURCE-BOUND CANDIDATE EXAMPLE / NOT ARCHETYPE DEFAULT
capacitance_example.limit: Ideal parallel-plate normalized value only; actual overlap, fringing, humidity, temperature, thickness and process state require bound inputs/measurement. No breakdown/working-voltage rating inferred.

boundaries: stack order is a compilation grammar, not universal process compatibility
X→Y compatibility is directional and must carry material/process evidence
geometry cannot create an absent active mechanism
seed components retain exact manufacturer and certification limits
physical, public, ecological, mission and carrier-promotion authorities remain separate
